revised_prompts:
Create one finished original vertical-scroll webtoon art shot, template webtoon-shot-v1. Canvas 1536x2048, keep 5% safe margin. Korean webtoon-style polished 2D scene, no text.

Scene purpose: show family role division through Bram’s short command and Kyle’s immediate movement.

Composition/camera: medium_full shot, low angle, normal lens feel, camera positioned from the south side of the dining table toward the door, facing Bram and Kyle; subtle movement-tracking feel. Focus on Bram giving the order and Kyle rising from a chair and moving his hand to a wooden training sword. Leave quiet empty space at top for two short command lines.

Characters:
1) Bram Waldhart on left side, around left 18% top 22%, width 31% height 62%, midground. Middle-aged broad-built man, short beard, short brown hair with some gray, forest-green doublet under dark sleeveless outer layer, no cloak. Pose: upright half-body near the open door, calm instant judgment, looking at Kyle. Action: giving a short sharp command to bring someone. Preserve mature rugged fantasy-medieval look from reference.
2) Kyle Waldhart on right side, around left 57% top 26%, width 28% height 60%, midground. Fourteen-year-old boy, reddish-brown tousled hair, slim teen build, plain blue jerkin with no emblem, no brooch, simple shirt, boots. Pose: pushing the chair back and half-rising to full body, expression changed from lightness to concentration, gaze between door and Bram. Action: gripping the hilt of a wooden practice sword at his waist, ready to depart. Wooden grain visible on the practice sword.

Background: Walt-fort dining hall based on rustic timber medieval room. Open door, small dining table left behind with still-warm soup and bread, chairs, fireplace, sideboards, window. Use a perspective where diagonal lines from table to door guide motion toward the two characters. Depth layers: table and chair in foreground, Bram and Kyle in midground, open door and corridor in background. Interior warm light remains, but cooler light spills from the doorway.

Visual treatment: clear linework emphasizing Kyle’s rising motion and Bram’s hand gesture. Color contrast of forest green, blue jerkin, and cool doorway light. Understated, non-exaggerated 2D tension, mood shifting from daily life to immediate response.

Continuity: screen direction left to right. State entering: urgent news just arrived, Kyle had been seated. State leaving: Bram is directing the situation, Kyle is ready to go, Theo remains at the table offscreen. No combat, no extra armor.

Important: no speech balloons, no captions, no readable text, no watermark, no signature, no duplicate characters.
